🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX falling (VXX 1W: -8.23% | 1M: -27.38%) BELOW TREND and SPY outperforming TLT (SPY 1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND; offset by rising credit stress signal (HYG/LQD flagged as stress ↑).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -27.38%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Stocks over bonds: SPY/TLT ↑ rising (SPY 1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND; credit signal mixed with HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +1.09%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.13%) ABOVE TREND but ratio flagged as stress ↑.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-supportive: Dollar UUP (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -1.87%) BELOW TREND showing modest weakness, yield curve in RECOVERY (↑ slight steepening) and TLT (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals leading: Financials XLF (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +10.76%) ABOVE TREND and Energy XLE (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND showing strength while Tech XLK (1W: +2.53% | 1M: +7.01%) ABOVE TREND keeps pace; style: Cyclicals/value showing relative strength vs defensives.

5. US vs Global?
US stronger: SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND; EM recovering: EEM (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +3.74%) ABOVE TREND; China mixed — FXI (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND but China tech (China Tech vs US Tech 1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.46%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation intact: ARKK (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +9.76%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +7.35%) ABOVE TREND; crypto set for short-term watch — IBIT (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +3.50%) CORRECTION.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Metals-led reflation: PPLT (1W: +24.00% | 1M: +50.83%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +43.13%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +4.48% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND driving commodity strength; CPER (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND adds industrial support.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy constructive: BNO (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +0.91%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas recovering from declines with UNG (1W: +6.61% | 1M: -11.95%) RECOVERY.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +5.57%) ABOVE TREND both positive; divergence flags minor — IBIT, XRT and XLP show 1W vs 1M mismatches (CORRECTION/RECOVERY) and HYG/LQD credit signal warrants monitoring.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals/value exposure (XLF 1W: +1.96% | 1M: +10.76% ABOVE TREND, XLE 1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.38% ABOVE TREND) and commodities exposure; reduce exposure to defensive utilities/real estate (XLU 1W: -0.23% | 1M: -2.58% BELOW TREND, XLRE 1W: +0.17% | 1M: -0.69% RECOVERY) and monitor credit stress.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If SPY/TLT remains ↑ → Financials XLF (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +10.76%) ABOVE TREND and Materials/Industrials (Materials 1W: +3.10% | 1M: +9.46% ABOVE TREND) to watch for leadership. BEARISH: If VXX reverses ↑ or HYG/LQD deteriorates → Utilities XLU (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -2.58%) BELOW TREND and Real Estate XLRE (1W: +0.17% | 1M: -0.69% RECOVERY).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Precious metals PPLT (1W: +24.00% | 1M: +50.83%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +43.13%) ABOVE TREND if risk-off hedging continues. BEARISH: Watch UNG (1W: +6.61% | 1M: -11.95%) RECOVERY for reversion risk and energy if economic data weakens.

13. Key Levels?
SPY/TLT 7.86 (stocks vs bonds ↑ rising) as risk-on pivot, HYG/LQD 0.73 (credit stress signal ↑) to monitor for credit deterioration, XLK/XLF 2.63 (tech vs financials ↑ rising) for style rotation, VXX 20 (VXX 1W: -8.23% | 1M: -27.38%) as complacency threshold.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive with VXX falling and SPY/TLT ↑ rising, while HYG/LQD flags rising credit stress. Cyclicals/value (XLF 1W: +1.96% | 1M: +10.76% ABOVE TREND, XLE 1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.38% ABOVE TREND) and commodities (PPLT 1W: +24.00% | 1M: +50.83% ABOVE TREND) showing strength. Key risk: monitor credit-signal divergence (HYG/LQD) and short-term corrections in IBIT/XRT/XLP.
